race.comment: DON'TPUSHSEND (10) is from the Hayes yard and they have been flying of late. They know which ones to bring to the country meetings. Has some gear on straight away which suggests they want to give him a very positive start. Must go into everything. LULL US AWAY (7) has shown excellent consistency of late. She once again has a lovely draw and can easily take advantage to be right in it. MIRRAWAY (8) didn't do a lot in her two outings at the start of the year. But her group of trials in the lead up to this suggests she can show much more now. DINGLE (5) has been a bit up and down. But the effort two back would have her right into the finish. Back home will help. FLASHMAN (1) is one to watch with the blinkers straight on at the debut. Market will tell.
